_note: Abstract resources — not physical, not hauled, but spent. Focus is the load-bearing one: it is generated only by pulling staff off productive work, so uncovering the truth always competes directly with keeping the lights on.

abstracts.name: Labour
abstracts.description: Worker-shifts. Every crew, porter and repair hand comes out of the same pool, and a shift nobody works is simply gone.

quote.text: The Shaft runs on three things: fuel, water, and people who haven't quit yet.

abstracts._note: Does not accumulate. Unused labour in a shift is simply lost.

abstracts.name: Focus
abstracts.description: The capacity to investigate, made by pulling staff off productive work. Every hour spent asking questions is an hour not spent fixing pumps.

quote.text: Curiosity is expensive. That's why the Archive keeps the receipts.

abstracts.meaning: Investigation capacity, generated by pulling staff off productive work
abstracts._note: The engine of story revelation. Every point of Focus is a point of Productivity not earned.

abstracts.name: Authority
abstracts.description: Political capital, spent to amend the Accord. Controversial laws cost more, and contradicting your own precedent costs more still.

quote.text: Authority is like fuel. You only notice it when it's gone, and by then the lights are out.

abstracts._note: Controversial laws cost more; contradicting your own precedent costs more still. Consistency is therefore itself a spendable resource.
